entities.summary: Eren Keskin is a Kurdish lawyer and human rights activist in Turkey. She is the vice-president of the Turkish Human Rights Association (İHD) and a former president of its Istanbul branch. She co-founded the project "Legal Aid For Women Who Were Raped Or Otherwise Sexually Abused by National Security Forces”, to expose abuses happening to women in Turkish prisons. She has been arrested, imprisoned, and the object of numerous lawsuits in relation to her human rights activities. Eren Keskin was a legal figures from Bursa (b. 1959-04-24, Bursa). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Eren Keskin's human rights activism and legal work in Turkey have had a significant regional impact, particularly for women's rights and prison reform. Her efforts have led to increased awareness and policy changes within the Turkish government.
